critical_code_review_comments: leagues_router.py L104 _upsert_league_user (ORIGINAL BUG): The port assumed a fresh users collection keyed by user_id. In Ace Chasers the shared users collection is keyed by uid (unique index). The original insert wrote a doc without a uid field -> Mongo inserted with uid:null the first time, then E11000 duplicate key on every subsequent league request (500). Fixed by keying find/upsert on uid and setting both uid and user_id, plus backfilling name (email/password Firebase signups have no displayName so the League Pydantic model was rejecting docs on ValidationError name required).

leagues_router.py get_current_user (compat shim): swallows the actual firebase_auth exception and always raises 'Not authenticated'. Fine, but consider bubbling the reason for 401s to speed future debugging.

AppHeader.jsx L13: shadow uses rgba(255,92,0,0.7) — an orange remnant NOT caught by the sed swap since it's an rgba tuple. Not visible enough to fail the design check but should become disc-gold rgba(245,197,66,...) for consistency.

LeagueDashboard.jsx uses api.get('/leagues') + api.get('/leagues/browse') in parallel — both are session-scoped Firebase calls. The pre-fix state meant one of them threw 500 and toast.error('Failed to load leagues') fired every time. Consider surfacing individual failures via Promise.allSettled so a broken browse endpoint doesn't hide the /leagues data.

leagues_router.py imports `requests` (sync) at L27 but the rest of the file is async — any handler that does a sync `requests.get(...)` will block the event loop. Not in the critical paths I exercised, but worth an audit.

rca of the issue: MERGE BUG #1 (auth bridge): The ported leagues code assumed its own users collection keyed by user_id. When mounted in Ace Chasers it shared db.users which has unique index on uid. _upsert_league_user did db.users.find_one({user_id: uid}) — always None — then insert_one(doc) with no uid field. First request wrote {uid:null, user_id:...}. Second request hit E11000 duplicate key uid:null. ALL /api/leagues, /api/rounds, /api/scorecards, /api/files/upload calls returned 500. RCA: shared-collection assumption + missing uid on the write. FIX: key on uid, upsert with $setOnInsert, backfill user_id/name on existing docs. MERGE BUG #2 (routes): The port kept its original standalone routes /dashboard and /create-league in dashboard/header/landing components, but App.jsx routes are /leagues and /leagues/new. Clicking the 'New League' or 'Create a League' CTA fell through to the catch-all Navigate to='/feed'. Users could reach /leagues, but literally could not create a league from the UI. FIX: 5 route strings updated to point to the new merged paths. Reproduction: sign up -> /leagues -> click any 'New League' button -> observe redirect to /feed (pre-fix).
